mapper.select: SELECT id, username, name, email, password_hash, bio, avatar_key, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.name, u.bio, u.avatar_key, (SELECT count(*) FROM follows f WHERE f.follower_id = u.id) AS following_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM follows f WHERE f.followee_id = u.id) AS follower_count, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM follows f WHERE f.follower_id = #{viewerId} AND f.followee_id = u.id) AS followed_by_me FROM users u WHERE u.username = #{username}

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.name, u.avatar_key, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM follows f WHERE f.follower_id = #{viewerId} AND f.followee_id = u.id) AS followed_by_me FROM users u WHERE u.username ILIKE '%' || #{pattern} || '%' ESCAPE '\' OR u.name ILIKE '%' || #{pattern} || '%' ESCAPE '\' ORDER BY CASE WHEN u.username = #{keyword} THEN 0 WHEN u.username LIKE #{pattern} || '%' ESCAPE '\' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, -- DB の照合順序（ロケール）によって「_」の並ぶ位置が変わるので、文字コード順（C）に固定する。開発と本番で並びをそろえるため u.username COLLATE "C" LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE username = #{username})
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE email = #{email})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (username, name, email, password_hash) VALUES (#{username}, #{name}, #{email}, #{passwordHash})
